projects.title: Crossing NATO Lines: Tracing Russia's GRU Explosive Parcel Bombs
projects.summary: An interactive visual investigation built with custom JavaScript injected into a CMS that didn't want to support it. I added a moving-camera effect to guide readers through a network of names and connections across several countries. The piece was named an Innovation of the Year in Polish media in 2026.

projects.title: Mapping Russia's War Machine on NATO's Doorstep
projects.summary: We used high-resolution satellite imagery to map Russian military base activity along NATO's eastern border. GRU special forces in Kaliningrad are being trained for sabotage operations, and new nuclear weapons infrastructure is taking shape in Belarus.
projects.coverAlt: Satellite image of the Asipovichy-2 military base with its buildings marked

projects.title: KREMLIN LEAKS: how Putin turned the Red Cross into a tool of propaganda and war
projects.summary: Leaked documents show how the Russian Red Cross, legally required to stay neutral, became a vehicle for Kremlin propaganda. We traced how Moscow uses it to extend influence abroad under the cover of the International Red Cross brand.

behind.title: KREMLIN LEAKS: how Putin turned the Red Cross into a tool of propaganda and war

projects.title: ANDROMEDA: Ukrainian puzzle
projects.summary: We tracked the yacht Andromeda, suspected in the Nord Stream pipeline explosions, by cross-referencing satellite imagery and AIS vessel tracking data. On-ground OSINT reporting led me to Kyiv, where I talked to a bad guy who wanted to run me over with his car.

behind.title: How a yacht with no trace led me over a fence in Kyiv

projects.title: Russian diplomatic facilities serve as SIGINT nests in Europe
projects.summary: We identified signals intelligence (SIGINT) equipment mounted on rooftops of Russian diplomatic facilities across Europe. Verified through satellite imagery and open-source research, the same setup appeared from Warsaw to Budapest, Stockholm, and Brussels.

projects.title: KREMLIN LEAKS: secret files reveal how Putin pre-rigged his reelection
projects.summary: Leaked Kremlin documents reveal the infrastructure behind Putin's reelection: a pan-Russian propaganda network, internet censorship machinery, and coordinated information warfare operations. We analyzed the files as part of a cross-border team.

projects.title: See Minsk and die
projects.summary: We traced financial flows linking companies in the Lukashenko regime's orbit to migrant smuggling networks bringing people from the Middle East into Europe. OSINT and on-ground reporting uncovered direct ties between the regime and the traffickers.

projects.title: RUSSIAN ASSET TRACKER
projects.summary: A joint OCCRP investigation with 25 newsrooms tracking the assets of Russian oligarchs on Navalny's Anti-Corruption Foundation list of 35. We covered Poland and Central Europe, cross-referencing property records, corporate filings, and public databases.

projects.title: Risk Map
projects.summary: Nearly 3.4 million police records reveal Poland’s most collision-prone municipalities, streets, and road sections.

projects.title: Brain at Full Throttle
projects.summary: A 3D brain that turns and lights up as you scroll through 24 hours, showing which areas work hardest at each time of day.
projects.coverAlt: A 3D brain with the prefrontal cortex highlighted in blue

projects.title: Poland’s 20 Best Beaches
projects.summary: A reader-powered ranking combining 50,000 calculator responses, field reporting, and an interactive map.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated ranking of Polish Baltic beaches

projects.title: A House from China
projects.summary: A nicer way to show China’s share of Polish imports, from doors and furniture to electronics. The house itself was drawn by AI, which let me experiment with different models and software.

behind.title: What have I learned from using AI to generate images?

projects.coverAlt: Cutaway illustration of a house and imported products

projects.title: Three decades of Polish politics, visualized
projects.summary: A Sankey diagram tracing thirty years of Polish political party history for a Polish print magazine. The same story also includes a radar diagram of political preferences. My first print commission, and the day I learned InDesign.

behind.title: My first job for the printed press and how I learned InDesign in one day

projects.title: Faster than Pizza Delivery: Poland's Online Drug Market Is Out of Control
projects.summary: I scraped 500,000 messages from 1,500 Telegram channels using Telethon and a snowballing method, then built a Doc2Vec classifier trained on 300 manually labeled drug ads to identify advertisements at scale. Presented the methodology at Dataharvest 2025 and won a couple of Polish awards for this work.

behind.title: How I created an ML model to uncover drug-trafficking on Telegram

projects.title: The map of toxic Poland
projects.summary: We automated 3,000 FOIA requests to map illegal waste dumps across Poland, then used an LLM to extract location data from PDF responses. The dataset revealed nearly 200 hazardous dump sites nationwide.

projects.title: How safe are you in Sumy during an air raid alert?
projects.summary: I used QGIS and official shelter location data from local authorities to map how well protected residents of Sumy region's largest cities actually are during air raid alerts. Made for my home region in Ukraine, dedicated to Kordon.Media.
projects.coverAlt: Map of air raid shelters in the largest cities of Sumy region

projects.title: Unpacking CEE's biggest oil company's promises to 'go green'
projects.summary: Orlen presents itself as a green energy leader. We dug into company filings and public data and found a company fighting to preserve oil refining profits, using Poland's slow green transition as cover. Published as a scrollytelling piece.

projects.title: Online neo-Nazi Store and Customers From Central Europe Exposed
projects.summary: A database of 20,000 purchases from the neo-Nazi webshop Midgård was leaked by the antifascist organization AFA. We analyzed the customer register to map how widespread its Central European sales network is, identifying buyers across Poland, Czechia, and Slovakia.

projects.title: FIREHOSE OF FALSEHOOD
projects.summary: We mapped a network of pro-Russian and alt-right disinformation sites operating across Central and Eastern Europe. Using network analysis, we showed how these sites cross-reference each other to amplify Russian narratives and spread conspiracy theories in local languages.

projects.title: Banknote mulch
projects.summary: During eight years of PiS rule, Polish forest districts funneled tens of millions in public funds to churches, nationalist organizations, and entities connected to the foresters themselves. We tracked the money using public spending data and a custom text classifier to categorize thousands of transfers.
